returns.nextId: The id of the next non-empty bin

setMaxBinStep(uint16).details: To be realistic, its highly unlikely a pool type with > 100 bin step is required. (>1% price jump per bin)

setMinBinSharesForDonate(uint256).details: Bin share is 1:1 liquidity when liquidity is first added. And liquidity: price * x + y << 128, where price is a 128.128 number.
